medicina.titulo: Experimental GLS-1 inhibitor demonstrates antitumor activity in advanced treatment-resistant ovarian cancer
medicina.resumo: Combining the experimental therapy IACS-6274 with targeted therapy bevacizumab and paclitaxel chemotherapy showed promising antitumor activity in a Phase I trial of patients with advanced platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, according to new results presented by researchers from The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.

medicina.titulo: Novel CAR-T platform uses radiation-activated switch to destroy tumors more effectively
medicina.resumo: Engineering patients' own immune cells to find and destroy cancer using chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has transformed the treatment of blood cancers. However, its use is limited in solid tumors because the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment prevents CAR T-cell entry into the tumor and causes cells that enter to become exhausted.

medicina.titulo: STAT+: Peptide market poised to explode with new Hims and Noom launches
medicina.resumo: Two telehealth giants rolled out peptide programs this week after HHS made it easier for compounding pharmacies to offer drugs like BPC-157.

medicina.titulo: STAT+: In cancer drug development, the spotlight shifts onto Erasca’s KRAS-targeted treatment
medicina.resumo: Did the biotech company Erasca find a more potent, better-tolerated pan-RAS cancer drug than Revolution Medicines?

biologia.titulo: Decoding interactomes: Supercomputing predicts bacterial protein links from shared evolutionary patterns
biologia.resumo: Predicting how proteins interact inside a cell is essential to understanding how organisms function and why they differ from one another, yet experimental hurdles and the computational cost of analyzing millions of protein pairs make it impossible to explore complete interaction networks, particularly in understudied bacteria and organisms.

biologia.titulo: Huge extinct orca may have eaten other whales
biologia.resumo: A nearly 8-metre-long species of orca lived in the North Sea over 2 million years ago. Its discovery suggests orcas evolved a diet of marine mammals earlier than scientists thought

biologia.titulo: Something strange is living beneath the skin of deep-sea pigs
biologia.resumo: Scientists have discovered a strange bacterium hiding beneath the skin of deep-sea creatures known as sea pigs, revealing an unexpected biological partnership. The microbe has an unusually tiny genome, yet more than a quarter of its DNA is devoted to making surface proteins, some of them exceptionally large. Researchers suspect it depends heavily on its host for survival, but what the sea pigs gain in return remains a mystery.

biologia.titulo: How cells use alternative genetic instructions to produce 'shadowing proteins'
biologia.resumo: The human genome contains tens of thousands of genes that provide instructions for making the proteins responsible for carrying out essential functions throughout the body. But those instructions may be more versatile than scientists once understood.

robotica.titulo: What industrial drone deployments reveal about real-world autonomy challenges
robotica.resumo: The engineering challenges of industrial drone autonomy include GNSS reliability, SLAM, sensor fusion, obstacle avoidance, and UAV validation. The post What industrial drone deployments reveal about real-world autonomy challenges appeared first on The Robot Report .

robotica.titulo: Six-inch robot could inspect nuclear waste pipes beyond reach of conventional cameras
robotica.resumo: How do you inspect underground pipes that carry contaminated waste from the inside out? It's a question the Hanford Site in Washington state has faced as it works to clean up the waste left by decades of nuclear production.

robotica.titulo: Featherweight flying robot carries its own sensors and computers
robotica.resumo: Over the past decade, MIT researchers have developed aerial microrobots with bumblebee-like speed, agility and durability for tasks like precision agriculture or search and rescue. But these featherweight microrobots couldn't carry the electronics needed for navigation, forcing them to remain connected to a motion-capture system in the lab.

robotica.titulo: Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX
robotica.resumo: Rockwell Automation has agreed to acquire autonomous mobile robot developer AGILOX, expanding its mobile robotics portfolio following its 2023 acquisition of OTTO Motors. The post Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX appeared first on The Robot Report .

software.titulo: Four PHP security releases including fixes for critical vulnerabilities
software.resumo: The PHP Project has announced the release of PHP 8.5.13 , 8.4.28 , 8.3.37 , and 8.2.36 . Each contains a number of security and bug fixes, including several fixes for critical vulnerabilities that could allow remote-code execution. According to the project's pre-release announcement on November 18, all of the vulnerabilities of critical severity " require either non-default configuration or uncommon setups ". See the release notes for details; Linux vendors and projects should be releasing updated packages soon.

software.resumo: The panelists explore how engineering teams adapt delivery architectures, pipelines, security, and governance for AI-assisted development. They share practical strategies for verifying AI-generated code, solving testing and deployment bottlenecks, maintaining human oversight, and measuring AI’s true impact on software velocity, quality, reliability, and operational cost. By Garima Bajpaj, Martin Reynolds, Patrick Debois, Gunnar Grosch, Renato Losio

hardware.titulo: Google lança Gemini 4 Neon para substituir Argon; veja o que muda
hardware.resumo: O Google começou a liberar o Gemini 4 Neon , novo modelo de inteligência artificial (IA) que substitui o Argon e o antigo Pro no aplicativo Gemini para assinantes do Google AI Pro . A novidade foi anunciada nesta quarta-feira (18) e promete melhora na análise de documentos, a programação e a execução de tarefas complexas. O Neon também está disponível para assinantes do Google AI Ultra e ocupa uma posição intermediária na família Gemini 4, entre o Hydrogen , voltado para atividades do cotidiano, e o Carbon , modelo mais avançado da empresa. Segundo o Google, a nova IA foi desenvolvida para combinar raciocínio avançado com respostas mais rápidas e menor consumo de recursos computacionais em determinadas tarefas. Com a mudança, o aplicativo Gemini passa a oferecer três modelos principais para assinantes do AI Pro: seleção automática, Hydrogen e Neon. astrofisica.titulo: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
astrofisica.resumo: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, humanity’s farthest-flying spacecraft, has reached one light-day from Earth, after more than 49 years of constant travel. A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, equaling about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). The spacecraft achieved the milestone at 2:16 a.m. PST (5:16 a.m. EST) Nov. 18. Voyager team […]

astrofisica.titulo: What's next for NASA interstellar Voyager 1 probe after passing 1 light-day from Earth?
astrofisica.resumo: The Voyager 1 probe continues to fly out into interstellar space after its historic distance milestone. NASA expects it to keep working until at least 2027.

astrofisica.titulo: Webb confirms first-of-its-kind merger of a supergiant and smaller sun-like star
astrofisica.resumo: Researchers recently identified a first of its kind: A star slightly less massive than the sun spiraled into and merged with a puffy supergiant star on the outskirts of our neighboring Andromeda galaxy. They nicknamed the newly single, potentially "rejuvenated" star Bao. Their discovery was then bolstered by quick-turn observations from NASA's James Webb Space Telescope that were carefully cross-referenced with extensive data from telescopes in space and on the ground.

astrofisica.titulo: Empire State Building glows gold for NASA's Voyager spacecraft | Space photo of the day for Nov. 19, 2026
astrofisica.resumo: The Empire State Building is illuminated in gold to celebrate Voyager 1 hitting one light-day from Earth.

computadores_pessoais.resumo: One "day" might not sound like a lot of time or distance, and in the vast emptiness of space, where everything is so far apart, it really isn't. computadores_pessoais.titulo: A bug in Nvidia’s drivers could damage your SSD
computadores_pessoais.resumo: Several users reported that Nvidia’s latest graphics drivers are writing large amounts of data to the SSD even when the computer is idling, according to Tom’s Hardware , citing posts on Nvidia’s forums . In some cases, this is said to amount to as much as 30 GB per hour. This report comes shortly after AMD fixed a similar issue in its graphics drivers . According to users, this affects, among others, the GeForce drivers 621.14 and 621.24. The problem appears to be linked to the background process NVDisplay.Container.exe, which repeatedly rewrites a log file on the computer’s storage device. On Nvidia’s forums, users report that Nvidia’s latest graphics drivers are writing large amounts of data to the computer’s SSD, even when the computer is not in use. PC för Alla One user measured around 3 GB of writes per hour with version 621.14, while another reports up to 30 GB per hour with the newer version 621.24. With the older driver, version 621.01, the write activity was significantly lower. computadores_pessoais.resumo: As VideoCardz notes, a full-size DDR5 stick measures just over 133 mm from end to end. The design JEDEC has in mind for DDR6 measures 74 mm, putting it within a few millimeters of those little SO-DIMMs found in laptops. computadores_pessoais.resumo: Your Windows desktop can get out of hand fast. You’ve got a dozen browser tabs open, three Word documents, a spreadsheet you swear was right there a minute ago, and an Outlook window buried underneath it all. Before long, you’re spending more time hunting down the window you need than actually working in it. You don’t need another productivity app to straighten things out. inteligencia_artificial.titulo: Meet Shepherd, the Meta-Agent Keeping Rogue AI In Check
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: AI agents are running amok on the internet, armed with commands to accomplish certain tasks but often acting in undesirable or unexpected ways. These rogue incidents run the gamut from deleting an entire email inbox to hacking websites and even launching cyberattacks . Much like human workers need managers, Weiyan Shi , an assistant professor at Northeastern University , believes AI agents require oversight. “They are running potentially for a long time. However, the longer they run, they may have some errors, and they may make some dangerous, unsafe actions. We feel like there should be a middle layer,” she says. This middle layer comes in the form of meta-agents that oversee behavior, provide quality control, and kick issues up the chain of command to a human when appropriate. “Worker agents are like the sheep wandering around, and the meta agent is like this shepherd trying to get them back on track,” Shi says. As such, Shi and her colleagues at Northeastern University and Stanford University named their framework Shepherd , an intelligent guide for agentic sheep. inteligencia_artificial.titulo: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
inteligencia_artificial.resumo: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.

energia_materiais.titulo: Harvesting electricity from prickly pear cacti
energia_materiais.resumo: In a greenhouse at the University of California, Santa Cruz, electricity gently hums, but it isn't coming from a lightbulb or socket. Instead, the voltage is being produced from the stems of prickly pear cacti, which researchers converted into living solar panels.

energia_materiais.titulo: Rooftop solar may reduce heat-related deaths by making cooling more affordable
energia_materiais.resumo: With intensifying climate change, extreme temperatures are becoming more common across the globe. Such extreme temperatures represent an urgent public health challenge that warrants both effective environmental and energy policy. Previous studies have linked both extreme heat and extreme cold to higher mortality risks, which are projected to grow as climate change increases the frequency and severity of temperature extremes. Addressing these threats requires effective climate adaptation measures, including ways to help people maintain safe indoor temperatures.

energia_materiais.titulo: A little manganese makes a big difference for next-generation batteries
energia_materiais.resumo: As electric vehicles become more widespread, researchers are looking for ways to make rechargeable batteries store more energy while reducing their cost and environmental impact. Aluminum is a promising candidate. It can store large amounts of lithium, and a single sheet of aluminum foil can serve as both the battery's active material and the component that carries electricity.

ciberseguranca.titulo: Vulnerabilidade crítica afeta milhões de sites, apps e serviços feitos em Java
ciberseguranca.resumo: Uma vulnerabilidade crítica no Java pode permitir que criminosos invadam sites, aplicativos e serviços que utilizam a linguagem de programação. Identificada como CVE-2026-114938 e chamada de Java4Shell , a falha permite a execução remota de códigos maliciosos, em alguns casos sem que o invasor precise de login ou senha. A brecha foi divulgada na terça-feira (17) pela empresa de segurança Calif e recebeu uma pontuação de 9,2 em uma escala de gravidade que vai até 10. A Oracle, responsável pelo Java, já disponibilizou atualizações para corrigir o problema. Segundo o Tom's Hardware, a exploração pode permitir o acesso a informações confidenciais, incluindo dados de usuários , e abrir caminho para o comprometimento de sistemas inteiros. O problema está no OpenJDK, implementação de código aberto do Java utilizada como base para diferentes distribuições da linguagem. Como essa tecnologia está presente em sistemas corporativos, servidores e aplicações na internet, a vulnerabilidade tem um alcance potencial elevado. Como funciona a vulnerabilidade no Java? O informante também afirmou que outras fabricantes estão pesquisando tecnologias semelhantes e que boa parte delas deve apresentar novidades em 2027. ciberseguranca.resumo: A OnePlus pode surpreender com uma tela OLED de 240 Hz em seu próximo celular topo de linha . Um novo vazamento aponta que a fabricante chinesa estuda usar um painel com essa taxa de atualização no OnePlus 17, previsto para 2027. O display também pode trazer resolução 2K e bordas ultrafinas. As informações foram divulgadas pelo informante Digital Chat Station, na rede social Weibo. Segundo ele, a BOE desenvolveu uma nova tela de 6,89 polegadas com especificações avançadas, que pode equipar um futuro smartphone da OnePlus. 📱 Veja as melhores promoções de celulares no WhatsApp do CT Ofertas O painel teria resolução 2K, suporte ao padrão de cores BT.2020 e um chip dedicado para controlar a exibição. Além disso, a tecnologia LIPO de nova geração permitiria bordas extremamente finas nos quatro lados da tela. OnePlus 17 pode dar salto na qualidade da tela Se os rumores forem confirmados, o OnePlus 17 terá um avanço considerável em relação ao antecessor. O OnePlus 16, lançado em outubro deste ano, tem uma tela OLED BOE X4 de 6,78 polegadas, resolução 1,5K e taxa de atualização de até 185 Hz em jogos compatíveis.
